Go back to IRC. There's tons of networks set up with automated bots that will fill requests for you. They're also a good place to get reviews of movies and shit before you download since the chat channels are usually active.
I really want to try the IRC seas again. Do you have any good starting points?

Go to that site I linked, search for something. It will bring up a list of direct results which will lead you to new channels you can use. Almost all the big channels are mostly automated and as long as you read the !help info they're usually pretty easy to use.
It's all about finding a good channel and then using that channel to find other channels. You'll have way more success if you're willing to actually talk to people and you can find a channel with an active chat community. Most of the people who hang out in these channels have been doing this for a while, some of them have been doing it since back in the BBS days. A lot of people are willing to help as long as you're not a complete dick or you actually contribute back in some fashion.

It's not as "reliable" as TPB or KAT but if you like the thrill of the hunt like I do and you don't mind delayed gratification, you can find some pretty solid sources and some stuff you can't find anywhere else, even private trackers.

Also, keep in mind that almost all channels do not serve up magnets or torrents, but rather serve you the actual files through DCC.
